anomalies.observed: The isolated CAN transceivers U45 and U48 have both GND1 and GND2 pins tied to the common GND net.
anomalies.expected: For isolated CAN buses, the transceiver primary ground (GND1) and secondary ground (GND2) should remain separate isolated grounds; tying them together defeats galvanic isolation.
